item.title: Where Is the U.S. Beating China on A.I., and Where Is It Lagging?
Trump and Chinese president Xi end summit without major agreement on AI
item.description:
# Trump and Chinese president Xi end summit without major agreement on AI Donald Trump and Chinese president Xi Jinping wrapped up [their Washington summit](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/sep/25/donald-trump-xi-jinping-china-president-us-visit-red-carpet-treatment) on Friday, facing criticism that they had squandered an opportunity to pause their countries’ artificial intelligence (AI) arms race.
But Trump – who has repeatedly said the US must forge ahead to maintain its lead over [China](https://www.theguardian.com/world/china) – appeared more focused on his push to rebrand artificial intelligence as “super intelligence”, later claiming on social media that Xi “seems to like” the term without divulging the substance of their discussions.

## College dropout, 23, takes on Zuckerberg in race to build AI assistant A 23-year-old college dropout has made himself a rival to Mark Zuckerberg in the race to build an [AI assistant](https://www.foxnews.com/category/tech/artificial-intelligence) that can handle everyday errands.
## Meta AI goes hunting for $1,000 in savings and comes back with $35 [Meta’s new AI assistant](https://www.foxnews.com/category/tech/artificial-intelligence) went looking for $1,000 in savings for one writer.
## Google's new AI laptop can read your screen and keep working after you close it From there, Google says, [its AI can analyze](https://www.foxnews.com/category/tech/artificial-intelligence) text and images on the screen.
## Google launching project to put AI data centers in space Google will load a refrigerator-sized satellite onto a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket Oct. 1, marking the tech giant's first concrete step toward building solar-powered [artificial intelligence](https://www.foxnews.com/video/6405540267112) data centers in orbit.
The chips can process simple [Gemini](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/artificial-intelligence-google-gemini-trump-09-20) queries for 15 minutes before needing to shut down and cool off.
## 'Pacing, not pausing': OpenAI exec rejects AI slowdown amid tech race with China As calls grow for artificial intelligence development to slow down following recent safety incidents, [OpenAI Chief Global Affairs Officer Chris Lehane](https://www.foxnews.com/video/6405540267112) argues that halting AI progress through excessive regulations would risk handing global technological leadership to China.

item.title: Syracuse University launches artificial intelligence research institute
item.description:
# Syracuse University launches artificial intelligence research institute Syracuse University launches artificial intelligence research institute Syracuse University [has created](https://news.syr.edu/2026/09/23/syracuse-university-launches-institute-for-artificial-intelligence/) a new institute focused on artificial intelligence research.
The [Institute for Artificial Intelligence](https://instituteai.syracuse.edu/) examines AI from four different lenses: security, multidomain intelligence, socio-cognitive dynamics and governance and policy, according to its website.
Chancellor Mike Haynie, who took over in April, has been finding ways to embed AI into research and school work. AI-bot Claude became available for all SU students, staff and faculty beginning last year.
[Research topics include](https://instituteai.syracuse.edu/research) advancing trust-worthy AI models, examining the interactions between AI and human behavior and integrating multiple sources of information.

item.description:

In the letter, Drummond and the coalition warn that unchecked AI development endangers Americans and poses a potential threat to the nation's financial system, critical infrastructure and national security.

Anthropic and Meta also acknowledged that their [AI agents had entered the open web](https://okcfox.com/news/nation-world/former-google-employee-adds-to-the-growing-voices-of-calls-to-slowdown-ai-industry-technology) and performed dangerous and unlawful actions.
